description: Create a standards-compliant sitemap.xml in seconds. Paste your page URLs, set change frequency and priority, then copy or download the file.

faqs.a: An XML file listing your site's pages so search engines can discover and crawl them efficiently.
Upload sitemap.xml to your website's root folder (e.g. example.com/sitemap.xml) and submit it in Google Search Console.
The sitemap protocol allows up to 50,000 URLs and 50 MB per file. For larger sites, split them into multiple sitemaps.
faqs.q: How many URLs can it contain?

howto: Paste your page URLs into the box, one per line.
Choose a change frequency, priority and whether to add trailing slashes.
Click Generate Sitemap to validate every URL and build the XML.
Copy the XML or download sitemap.xml and upload it to your site root.
title: Sitemap Generator
